urls.title: URLs
urls.description: URLs or domains to check, one per line. Up to 50,000 per run.

checkSsl.title: Check SSL certificate
checkSsl.description: For https URLs, report certificate expiry date, days left, issuer and validity.

maxRedirects.title: Max redirects
maxRedirects.description: Stop following redirects after this many (reported as an error).

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel requests
maxConcurrency.description: Overall parallelism. Each host gets at most ~2 requests per second.
